newsitem.title: EGYPT: Builders find Pharaonic tomb in Cairo district.
newsitem.headline: Builders find Pharaonic tomb in Cairo district.

text.p: Egyptian construction workers have found an ancient Pharaonic tomb complete with clay sarcophagi while digging the foundations for a garage in the Cairo district of Helmiet el-Zeitoun, Al-Akhbar daily said on Monday.
The tomb, which experts at the Supreme Council of Antiquities said dated back 2,000 years, contains four empty sarcophagi inscribed with hieiroglyphics and clay utensils, the newspaper added.
The council would carry out a sweep of the residential district to find out if there were any more antiquities underneath it, al-Akhbar said.
